title: West Africa Daily Intelligence Brief
executive_summary: Today's West Africa briefing is shaped primarily by politics, economy and security. Significant developments are concentrated in Niger, Côte d'Ivoire, Togo, The Gambia. Security pressures remain an important source of political and humanitarian risk; while economic policy and market conditions continue to influence investor confidence and household welfare.

learning.title: Understanding the central Sahel
learning.description: The central Sahel commonly refers to Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger. The area has experienced persistent militant violence, military intervention in politics and severe humanitarian pressure.

methodology: Stories are collected from public Google News RSS searches, classified using keyword rules, filtered for near-duplicates and ranked using source quality, recency and political-risk relevance.
